thread:
Anya: Quick q — legal asked for a "who changed route quotas" export. Can we make a straightforward NDJSON export that includes actor + justification + the bucket diff? Need to surface in console too.
Matt: do we need full payload? diff + actor id might be enough.
Sophie: Legal specifically wants email, role, and free-text justification. Also ability to redact free-text on export.
Julia: UI idea — in the change modal show diff + a "Download full export" action which opens presigned link. Also show whether change was part of a canary.
Kevin: API shape proposal: each line = {action, actor, timestamp, resource, before, after, reason, rollout_id, proof_hash}. For enterprise mode include resolved_actor with email.
Anya: Two export modes: "full" (enterprise only) and "pseudonymized" (alias + id). Default to pseudonymized.
ops-bot: Export job queued (id: ex-8732). ETA ~3h. Size est 1.2GB.
Sophie: Telemetry: emit audit_export.requested with tenant_id, export_mode, initiated_by, sample_count. Also record export_quota_remaining.
Matt: Implementation notes — NDJSON gzipped, store to tenant S3 bucket, provide presigned GET. Also sign a manifest with proof_hashes so we can later verify integrity.
Julia: On console, filter by actor_role, route_namespace, and rollout id. Show inline diff + link to open in Explorer with context.
Kevin: Retention concern — if 'before' crosses retention we should show hash only and store redacted body in cold archive.
Anya: Also add 'justification' field, but surface a warning that it's retained in logs and access is audited.
Sophie: Legal also wants export API to accept filters: from_ts/to_ts, actor_ids, action_types, include_sensitive=(true|false).
Matt: Rate limiting: default 1 export / 24h per tenant; escalate via contract for more.
Julia: Example NDJSON line:
{"action":"policy.update","actor":{"id":"U123","email":"anya@redwood.ai","role":"admin"},"resource":"routing:tenant:acme/routes/42","before":{"buckets":[{"id":"b1","weight":80}]},"after":{"buckets":[{"id":"b1","weight":60}]},"reason":"hotfix reduce latency","timestamp":"2026-03-21T18:05:00Z","rollout_id":"ro-998","proof_hash":"sha256:abcd..."}
Matt: Any objections? If not I'll draft the export API spec and a console mock.
Sophie: 👍 please include the telemetry metrics and quota enforcement in the spec.
Anya: Thanks — let's reconvene after the spec draft.
